project.title: Anaerobic microbial chain elongation using formate and ethanol metagenome
project.description: This project investigates microbial communities and functional potentials associated with anaerobic chain elongation using formate and ethanol as co-substrates. Formate-ethanol and acetate-ethanol systems were compared to evaluate differences in the production of four-carbon to six-carbon carboxylic acids, microbial community composition, and metabolic functions involved in substrate conversion and reverse beta-oxidation. Metagenomic sequencing was performed to characterize microbial populations and functional genes associated with butyrate and caproate formation. This study supports the development of a staged electrochemical-biological platform in which carbon dioxide-derived formate and ethanol can serve as intermediates for microbial upgrading into higher-value carboxylic acids.
